text: The plant platform (+15.00 m) is far above the ER-02.09 minimum floor level of +1.90 m (TQ-041). Structures at the shoreline (intake head works, CW pump house, outfall seal pit) shall have their floors at least at +5.3 m (50-year wave run-up +4.8 m plus 0.5 m, TQ-041); parts below these levels (pits, sumps, intake and outfall works) shall be watertight and designed for flooding. The check is documented in CV-CAL-0001.
